headline: Purchases from AliExpress and Temu to be taxed from the first euro: Rada passes VAT law on parcels - sud.ua
summary: Under a law passed by the Rada, VAT will be charged on online purchases up to 150 euros, paid by marketplaces. Non-commercial parcels up to 45 euros remain untaxed.
why: Changes to VAT on low-value cross-border e-commerce affect marketplace pricing and their cost base. AliExpress and Temu are major cross-border platforms selling into Europe.
